context.content: I'm considering getting a Revolut or a TransferWise card in addition, simply because of the three biggest banks in the Netherlands (ABN, ING, Rabo) it's only mine (because why would it be any of the other) that doesn't support Garmin Pay. Not that I *truly* need Garmin Pay everyday but it could be useful if I go to the toilet at the train station and don't want to fish out my wallet or phone and it's annoying as fuck that [they haven't managed to implement it in the last 2-3 years](https://twitter.com/ingnl/status/1070060574153814016).
